# EvCarousel

> A carousel displays a set of items in a scrollable horizontal or vertical track, with previous/next navigation buttons and a position indicator. It supports multiple content aspect ratios.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:carousel` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvCarousel } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvCarousel>` or `<ev-carousel>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/carousel/EvCarousel.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-carousel">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvCarousel>
  <EvCarouselSlide>Slide 1</EvCarouselSlide>
  <EvCarouselSlide>Slide 2</EvCarouselSlide>
  <EvCarouselSlide>Slide 3</EvCarouselSlide>
</EvCarousel>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvCarouselSlide` (`evoq-ui:carousel-slide`).

## Props (8)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modelValue` | `number` | `0` | no | Index of the slide in view. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal'` \| `'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | no | — |
| `ratio` | `'16:9'` \| `'9:16'` \| `'4:5'` \| `'5:4'` \| `'1:1'` \| `string` | `'16:9'` | no | Applied to every slide. The usage doc is explicit that one carousel keeps a single ratio throughout, so it lives here rather than on each slide. |
| `showButtons` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Figma's `Need Button`: the previous/next controls. |
| `showIndicator` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Figma's `Has Indicator Slot`: the position dots. |
| `previousLabel` | `string` | `'Sebelumnya'` | no | — |
| `nextLabel` | `string` | `'Berikutnya'` | no | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | no | Accessible name for the carousel. |

**Two-way binding:** `v-model`

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Carousel**, frame `4597:11479` (Carousel). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to browse a set of related images or cards in a confined space.
- Use Horizontal for wide, gallery-style content; Vertical for stacked feeds.
- Use the aspect ratio that matches the media (16:9 video, 1:1 thumbnails, 9:16 stories).
- Use the indicator so users know their position within the set.
- Use navigation buttons on pointer surfaces where swipe is not available.

### When not to use

- Don't mix different aspect ratios within a single carousel.
- Don't hide both the buttons and the indicator at once.
- Don't overload one carousel with too many items.
- Don't use a carousel for primary navigation  →  use Tabs (`evoq-ui:tabs`) or a List.

### Do

- Keep slot content uniform in size and aspect ratio.
- Show at least the active plus an adjacent item to hint scrollability.
- Pair the indicator with buttons for accessible navigation.
- Keep one consistent aspect ratio across all slots.

### Don't

- Mix aspect ratios within one carousel.
- Hide both navigation buttons and the indicator.
- Cram too many items into a single carousel.
- Use it as the only way to reach important content.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvCarousel`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-carousel">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:carousel` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
